Class MapToolHandler

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.container.BaseToolHandler
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.container.MapToolHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
IToolHandler
public class MapToolHandler extends BaseToolHandler
Map-specific tool handler that overrides creation gestures to produce map-native items whose geometry is stored in geographic coordinates rather than projection-space world coordinates.

Military symbol placement is handled entirely by drag-and-drop in MapContainer. This handler is responsible only for the normal map drawing tools such as line, polyline, polygon, and text.
